From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>

Subject: Meridian pilot - ask for one-time introductory pricing

Marissa —

Quick summary and ask: Meridian Labs (prospect) is proposing a 3-month strategic pilot (approx. 2.5M tokens/month peak, then a phased ramp) across two product teams. They signed an NDA and want a short-term, reduced rate to get buy-in across their engineering org.

Why I think we should consider an exception:
- Strategic fit: Meridian is a well-networked OEM in biotech; successful pilot could anchor a larger roll-out and a co-marketing case study.
- Contract potential: They sign to a full commercial agreement after pilot; indicated willingness to commit to a 12‑month, multi-region deployment if pilot metrics are met.
- Technical constraints: They need guaranteed throughput for batched inference during peak windows — they'd prefer Dedicated but will start hosted.

Ask: Approval for a one-time 30% introductory discount on hosted rates for the 3-month pilot plus a $25k onboarding credit (apply as invoice credit) — total concession estimated at ~$42k. We propose standard terms otherwise (net 30), pilot SOW attached.

Key conditions we want baked in if approved:
1) Pilot acceptance criteria and metrics in SOW (latency SLA4, quality thresholds).
2) Auto-roll into standard commercial rates unless explicit opt-out.
3) Full payment on schedule for any usage above capped pilot volumes.

I can get procurement and legal looped in once you give the go/no-go. Tom and Elena from Meridian are on copy and ready to accelerate.

Thanks — Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Mobile: 415-555-0199

I've run a quick P&L on the proposed concession:
- Estimated pilot revenue (after 30% discount): $98k over 3 months.
- Cost of service (infrastructure + support): ~$34k.
- Onboarding credit: $25k applied as a one-time write-off reduces gross margin in Q3.
- Net presentable: with our lifetime value assumptions (conversion to 12-month contract at 4x pilot run rate), the NPV is positive.

Recommendation: Approve up to 25% introductory discount + $15k onboarding credit. Any extra concession requires CFO sign-off. Also recommend staged credit release: $10k at signature, $5k at pilot midpoint.

If Sales wants to keep 30% + $25k, we need Rafael to prepare a short memo for CFO outlining strategic upside and mitigation (co-marketing agreement, committed minimum). -> I'll draft the memo if you confirm.

-Rafael
